apps.name: Predictive SPC
apps.summary: Explore estimated out-of-spec and selected control-rule risks over the next several samples.
apps.why: For teams seeking earlier warning of changing process behavior.
required_data: For customization: time-ordered measurements, timestamps, part and machine identifiers, targets and specification limits
Relevant process parameters and shift context; representative history for model validation
outputs: Future OOS and selected rule-risk estimates
Part/machine status dashboard and date-time filtering
Feature relationships, what-if exploration, and suggested setpoint/action panels
apps.limitations: The supplied app uses generated demo data, not a customer upload. Its rule-risk model covers selected Nelson-like patterns, not all eight Nelson rules. Associations and model suggestions do not establish causes or guarantee improvement.
customizations: Discuss your data connections, workflow, and reporting requirements with Hertzler. Scope and feasibility are assessed before any commitment.
apps.demo_instructions: Use the built-in synthetic data. Select a part, machine, and date-time range; explore Detail View and Current Status Dashboard.

apps.name: Batch Anomaly Detection
apps.summary: Identify unusual existing batches, lots, or work orders using measurements and process parameters.
apps.why: For teams comparing production groups and investigating what makes a batch unusual.
required_data: CSV with a batch, lot, or work-order grouping column
At least three selected numeric features
Part/SKU column where available; optional timestamp and machine/operator/shift context
outputs: Group-level anomaly scores and exports
Adaptive anomaly threshold and feature association indicators
Category anomaly rates and anomalous-versus-normal group comparisons
apps.limitations: This code detects anomalies in existing groups; it does not predict future batch defects. Scores are not defect probabilities, and contribution indicators do not prove causes.
customizations: Discuss your data connections, workflow, and reporting requirements with Hertzler. Scope and feasibility are assessed before any commitment.
apps.demo_instructions: In the sidebar change Use to Demo data, select a part and grouping column, then choose at least three numeric features.

apps.name: Mislabel Detection
apps.summary: Find records that behave differently from their declared part type and explore possible alternative types.
apps.why: For teams investigating potential part-label mismatches or unusual measurements within a declared type.
required_data: CSV with declared part type or label
At least three numeric measurement/process features
Record ID optional; reference data for multiple types needed to suggest alternatives
outputs: Within-type anomaly flags and CSV export
Cross-type fit suggestions and per-feature z-scores
Completeness checks, scatter plots, PCA, distributions and correlations
apps.limitations: An anomaly is not proof of a wrong label. The displayed alternative-type likelihood is a heuristic fit score, not a calibrated probability. Missing feature values can reduce usable records.
customizations: Discuss your data connections, workflow, and reporting requirements with Hertzler. Scope and feasibility are assessed before any commitment.
apps.demo_instructions: Choose Demo Data in Data Source, map the part label and at least three numeric features, then select Analyze Data.

apps.name: Smart Inspection Frequency
apps.summary: Evaluate inspection intervals using process capability, control-rule flags, recorded failures and estimated drift.
apps.why: For teams assessing how frequently to inspect each process using measurement history and specifications.
required_data: Two Excel workbooks: measurement export and standards; both require a Part Number column
The export requires Date/Time plus numeric measurement columns and selected process grouping columns
At least 15 rows/subgroups per group; select specification limits, target and subgroup-size fields where available
Optional Real-time failures column and chart-type field
outputs: Suggested interval in hours and frequency label for each group
Capability, control-rule flags per week, recorded failure rate, drift estimate and risk level
Comparison with the current median inspection interval
Inspection frequency/matrix tables and downloadable Excel workbook, including excluded groups
apps.limitations: Intervals are heuristic recommendations, not validated guarantees. Groups below 15 subgroups are excluded; rule flags are suppressed below 20 observations. Missing failure records are treated as zero and insufficient drift evidence can use a 72-hour fallback, so missing data must not be interpreted as proof of low risk. Use consistent standards per part and review intervals against process and inspection requirements.
customizations: Discuss customer-specific grouping, data connections, reports and interval rules with Hertzler; scope and feasibility require assessment.
apps.demo_instructions: Choose Use GitHub repo files if the deployed workbooks are available, or upload both Excel files. Select grouping and measurement columns, map specifications and subgroup size, set the safety factor, and click Build inspection frequency.

apps.name: SPC Auto-Interpretation
apps.summary: Explain control-chart rule signals with potential causes and investigation actions.
apps.why: For teams who want context and next steps when a chart signals unusual process behavior.
required_data: For customization: time-ordered subgroups, part/machine context, and an appropriate chart baseline
Optional verified past-event causes and actions for matching by part, machine and rule
outputs: X-bar chart and optional R chart
Nelson, Western Electric, simplified AIAG and custom rule selections
Past-event or generalized interpretation, hover details and downloadable findings
apps.limitations: This version runs on synthetic subgroups of size 2–10 and demo past events; it has no customer-file upload. Suggested causes require investigation. The AIAG option is explicitly simplified.
customizations: Discuss your data connections, workflow, and reporting requirements with Hertzler. Scope and feasibility are assessed before any commitment.
apps.demo_instructions: Select a part and machine, choose a rule set, and switch between past, generalized, or hybrid interpretation.

apps.name: Operator Data Integrity Checker
apps.summary: Review unusual entry timing, repeated values, and other data-entry patterns.
apps.why: For teams investigating possible entry errors and records needing follow-up.
required_data: CSV or Excel with operator, entry timestamp, and numeric measurement
Optional actual inspection timestamp, part, machine, test and target
outputs: Rule-based record risk scores and reasons
Operator summaries, batch-entry timing, repeated-value and low-variation analysis
Downloadable results
apps.limitations: Rule-based flags do not establish misconduct or intent. Thresholds and patterns need process-specific review. This is not an out-of-spec detector.
customizations: Discuss your data connections, workflow, and reporting requirements with Hertzler. Scope and feasibility are assessed before any commitment.
apps.demo_instructions: Start with Use Demo Data, review the dashboard tabs, and adjust detection thresholds in the sidebar.

apps.name: AI Database Health Assistant
apps.summary: Review SQL Server storage, indexes, query performance, blocking and available query history.
apps.why: For teams investigating database slowness, storage pressure, or maintenance concerns.
required_data: Demo mode needs no database connection
Real use requires SQL Server connectivity, an ODBC driver and appropriate diagnostic permissions
Historical query views require available Query Store data
outputs: Rule-based health scores and prioritized issues
Storage, tables, fragmentation, missing-index suggestions and blocking views
Cached query statistics, Query Store history, supported-question answers and report export
apps.limitations: Diagnostics are read-only; suggested maintenance SQL is not executed. Scores and recommendations are heuristic. Diagnostic history depends on SQL Server data availability; this is not a full integrity check or automatic repair service.
apps.demo_instructions: Keep Mode set to Demo Database. Explore the tabs and supported Ask Database questions.
customizations: Discuss your data connections, workflow, and reporting requirements with Hertzler. Scope and feasibility are assessed before any commitment.

apps.name: Certificate of Analysis Generator
apps.summary: Create a certificate preview and downloadable reports from selected quality measurements.
apps.why: For teams preparing customer-facing quality certificates for selected production records.
required_data: CSV or Excel columns: Part, Characteristic, Value, LSL, Target, USL
Optional lot, batch, customer, order, revision and unit fields
outputs: Flexible traceability filters and certificate preview
Per-characteristic results, PASS/FAIL and capability summary
Word export when the document dependency is installed, and Excel export
apps.limitations: Use consistent specifications and units for each grouped characteristic; the code uses the first specification values in each group. Approval names are text fields, not an electronic approval workflow. Generated compliance wording requires review.
apps.demo_instructions: Use the demo data, choose traceability fields and values, complete certificate settings, then preview and download.
customizations: Discuss your data connections, workflow, and reporting requirements with Hertzler. Scope and feasibility are assessed before any commitment.

apps.name: Manufacturing Copilot
apps.summary: Request manufacturing charts, comparisons, and dashboards using supported typed or voice commands.
apps.why: For teams wanting quicker access to quality charts by part, machine, or characteristic.
required_data: CSV or Excel with Timestamp, Part, Machine, Characteristic, Value, LSL, Target, USL
Typed requests work without a microphone; voice input needs microphone/browser support
outputs: Control charts, trends, histograms, scatter plots, EWMA, CUSUM and other supported charts
Comparisons and dashboards by part, machine or characteristic
Capability, OOS and selected rule summaries; tables on request
apps.limitations: Requests use predefined keyword/entity parsing rather than an unrestricted AI model. The uploaded version focuses on SPC; DMS and OEE analysis are not established by this source. Unsupported wording may produce a default summary.
apps.demo_instructions: Choose Demo data and try an Example question, such as Create a dashboard for P1 or Compare M1 vs M2 for P2 Length.
customizations: Discuss your data connections, workflow, and reporting requirements with Hertzler. Scope and feasibility are assessed before any commitment.

apps.name: Process Optimization
apps.summary: Explore process parameter settings predicted to bring measurements closer to target.
apps.why: For teams evaluating adjustable parameters for each part and machine.
required_data: Data CSV with part, machine, numeric process parameters and measurements
Separate specifications CSV with part and target; LSL/USL optional
At least 10 usable rows per part-machine group in this version
Measurements may be a single column or wide subgroup columns such as Data1..DataN
outputs: Optimized parameter settings within selected bounds
Predicted measurement, distance from target and specification checks
CSV results, failure reasons and reusable mapping settings
apps.limitations: The active configuration uses linear regression. Displayed error is predicted distance from target, not cross-validated accuracy. Historical relationships do not prove that changing a setting causes the predicted result; validate suggested settings in a controlled trial.
apps.demo_instructions: Select Use repo data and Load / Refresh files if the demo CSVs are deployed; otherwise upload DATA and SPECS CSVs. Map fields, choose parameters and review bounds.
customizations: Discuss your data connections, workflow, and reporting requirements with Hertzler. Scope and feasibility are assessed before any commitment.
